name: The Chess Club
description: Regulars at the chess club each swear by a different opening, a favourite tactic, and a prized set. Work out who plays what.
clues: Magnus, Nadia, and Vera go with 2211, 2nd, and 1st, in some order.

Exactly one of these is true: Nadia goes with Slav; Caro-Kann goes with 1911; 2111 goes with 4th.

Either 1911 goes with Vera or Magnus goes with 3rd.
